title: Host finding: workers' whole-suite runs refused at the darwin seconds ceiling on a loaded host, two of three tries, in SP-b7wibqok
goal: The operator decides from the recorded test.run rows of SP-b7wibqok (refused at 24 to 29 s, passing at 23.6 to 23.96 s, load about 3.7) what the suite's darwin headroom should be; nothing changes the ceiling without that decision
